newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - NRW April CPI later on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - NRW April CPI later on Tuesday.

text.p: The German state of North Rhine-Westphalia said on Tuesday it will release its consumer price data for April during the afternoon.

North Rhine-Westphalia is one of four states whose consumer inflation data are used to calculate preliminary consumer inflation for west Germany, which is scheduled to be announced on April 25 or April 28.
The state of Hesse has said it hopes to publish its data on Thursday. Baden-Wuerttemberg has said its figures will come on Thursday at the earliest and probably on Friday.
Bavaria said it expected to report its data on Thursday or Friday.
In March, the west German consumer price index fell by 0.1 percent month-on-month and rose by 1.6 percent year-on-year.
The pan-German consumer price index fell by 0.2 percent month-on-month and rose by 1.5 percent year-on-year.
